title: Bound journal-capacity lifecycle witnesses without changing production limits
outcome: Capacity and reclamation witnesses remain behaviorally meaningful with bounded real lifecycle transitions, while production retains the 1024 journal limit and full-size boundary coverage.
acceptance: The three journal-capacity witnesses exercise real naming and reclamation beyond an isolated fixture capacity with a bounded number of transitions, preserving monotonic generations, retained custody, retirement publication and acknowledgement, restart behavior and final journal assertions.

The production journal limit remains 1024 and production retention and protection behavior is unchanged; full-size admission, refusal and census coverage remains, and the fixture capacity cannot affect another state or survive an unintended restart.

Focused behavioral tests pass on the candidate without raised timeouts or removed assertions, and original runtime evidence plus the source analysis of live naming and compaction costs remains recorded.
